card.name: Punctuation inside MAOI and serotonergic lists
card.fires_on: Commas, closing parentheses and linking words like with, or and and, in lists of interacting drugs or foods to avoid, mostly in MAOI and serotonin-syndrome warnings.

modes.label: Commas in drug lists
modes.description: A comma or closing bracket after an item in a list of serotonergic drugs or foods to avoid.

modes.label: Links before MAOI drugs
modes.description: The word with or or just before linezolid or methylene blue in start-of-treatment warnings.
modes.example: being treated with linezolid<< or>> intravenous methylene blue

card.plain: It fires on the commas and small linking words that sit between items in lists of drugs or foods that interact with MAOIs.
